Higher-resolution 2K (2304×1296) indoor camera with AI-assisted motion tracking. Auto-follows the subject, one-touch talk button, Alexa compatible.

  • Smart motion tracking — camera follows movement
  • Alexa voice control for live-view
  • MicroSD up to 128GB, free 30-day cloud trial

Full-range 360° indoor monitor. 355° horizontal / 110° vertical PTZ with 4x digital zoom. Two-way talk, night vision to 30ft. Ships same-to-next day from California warehouse.

products.title: Wireless 1080p Indoor Security Camera

Entry-level indoor WiFi camera. Crisp 1080p feed, two-way audio, night vision, MicroSD + cloud storage. Smart-home friendly via app.

products.title: Mini Hidden Nanny Cam 1080p
products.body_html:
Thumb-sized hidden cam for indoor use. Loops onto MicroSD, triggers on motion. Fits in a bookshelf, smoke-detector casing, or desktop clutter.

  • 1080p full HD, ~30fps
  • Motion-activated + continuous modes
  • Night vision via built-in IR LEDs (~15ft range)
  • USB powered for 24/7, or built-in battery for ~2hr portable

products.title: Pocket Pen HD Hidden Camera
products.body_html:
1080p HD camera disguised as a working ballpoint pen. Silent record, no visible lens. Built-in rechargeable battery for ~90 minutes continuous, MicroSD storage up to 32GB.

  • Recording: 1080p MP4 at 30fps
  • Battery: ~90 min continuous
  • Trigger: single button, tactile feedback
  • Comes with USB-C cable + pen ink refill

products.title: 4K Mini WiFi Pinhole Hidden Camera
products.body_html:
Pinhole-lens hidden WiFi camera. Tiny enough to mount inside a DIY enclosure (screw head, book, smoke detector). Streams 4K via app, logs to SD card or cloud.

  • Motion-triggered alerts + night vision
  • Works with iOS + Android
  • MicroSD up to 128GB supported

products.title: Night Vision 1080P Resolution Portable Mini Camera
products.body_html:
This night vision spy camera is quite mini and portable for you to record videos for various purposes such as lesson learning, concert living recording.

It features full HD 1080p video resolution which makes you feel like being personally on the scene.

The IR LED light brings you clear night vision as well.

What' more, it can work as a car cam for recording road condition in driving, reliable witness for your safe driving.

It comes with a TV out cable, support TV output, TV monitor video connection.

Features

- Pocket mini camera, can be taken easily for outdoor video recording without being noticed.
- 140°wide angle lens to reduce blind spots and have a wider view.
- 1080P resolution allows you shoot clear and smooth video or images.
- Seamless Loop recording, automatic seamless video recording in loop to use the storage efficiently, with the earliest unlocked video clips being overwritten.
- Support TF card up to 32GB (Memory card not included) to store more wonderful videos and photos.
- Rotating 360 degrees back splint and 90 degrees bracket for different shooting angle requirements.
- IR LED light offers you clear night vision as well. Perfect for home office security and secret monitoring.

Specifications

- Color: Blue , Black or Red


- Material: Metal


- Size: Approx. 2.3 x 2.3 x 2.3 cm/ 0.9 x 0.9 x 0.9 inch (LxWxH)
- Image Resolution: 12MP (4032 x 3024)
- Video Resolution: 1080P (1920 x 1080P),720P (1280 x 720P)
- Video Frame Rate: 30fps
- Image Proportion: 4 : 3
- Decode Format: M-JPEG
- Video format: AVI
- Image Format: JPG
- Audio System: Built-in microphone/speaker (AAC)
- Special function: Loop recording, motion detection, TV out
- USB Function: USB-Disk
- Interface Type: Mini 8Pin USB
- USB Version: USB 2.0
- Battery Capacity: 200mAh
- Support TF card: Up to 32G (Card is not included)
- Working Time: About 100 Minutes at 1080P 30Fps
- Charging Time: About 2 - 3 Hours
- Charging Voltage: DC 5V

products.body_html: This advanced surveillance camera provides clear monitoring for your home or office perimeter. The weatherproof design and digital zoom make it a reliable choice for any outdoor security setup.

  • Operating range: -20°C to +40°C
